market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near flat to modestly higher at midday, the 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.08%-5.10%, and oil remained elevated near $100 amid Iran-war supply risk. Initial jobless claims are due before Thursday's open.

consensus_method.disparity_formula: Average of half the Pass A/B/C direction-score range and the Pass A/B/C reversal-risk range, rounded to 0-100.
consensus_method.lessons_review: Existing method applied; no new method change.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record $230B backlog and raised outlook support the setup; program charges remain the main counterweight.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus expects about $7.5 EPS and $20.7B revenue; the market is focused on backlog conversion and segment margins.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Clean conversion of the $230B backlog and another guide raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Program losses, supplier constraints, or weaker cash conversion.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable company-specific implied move was found; defense positioning is supportive but crowded.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior guidance was raised after 11% Q2 sales growth and $65B of new orders.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record operating momentum and $8.1B September-quarter guidance favor upside, moderated by a demanding AI-memory bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Street revenue estimates cluster near $8.1B-$8.3B and EPS near $2.18-$2.22.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Above-guide revenue plus durable HBM/advanced-node demand and firm margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Only an in-line guide, China mix weakness, or margin normalization.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public sources did not provide a stable consensus move; semicap positioning appears optimistic.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimates sit near or slightly above management's $8.1B midpoint and $2.15 EPS midpoint.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Subscriber scale and record gross margin create a positive setup if price increases hold without harming net adds.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 reached 300M Premium subscribers, 777M MAUs and 33.4% gross margin; the market now needs continued adds and margin durability.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Premium adds beat, ARPU improves, and gross margin stays around 33%.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: MAUs/subscribers miss or Q4 margin guidance retreats on content and AI costs.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move was found; investor attention is growth-and-margin focused.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent operating momentum is strong; current revision breadth was not reliably available.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broad Q2 recovery and falling inventory days favor another constructive print, provided Q4 confirms industrial and auto durability.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.42-$2.44 EPS on roughly $5.92B revenue, near the upper half of company guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Industrial/auto growth broadens, inventories normalize, and Q4 guidance holds momentum.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A cautious Q4 guide or renewed auto/industrial digestion.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options sources cited an unusually large move near 8.6%-9.4%, raising the bar for magnitude.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: One recent analyst retained Buy and lifted a price target; broader revisions appear positive but incomplete.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Exceptional refining economics support upside, but spot energy volatility makes the forward margin signal more important than headline EPS.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Crack spreads and utilization remain strong and management signals durable cash return.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Rapid normalization in crude/products or maintenance guidance cuts the run-rate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable implied move was found; oil-war headlines can overwhelm company execution.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimate direction is strongly positive in public previews, but the earnings bar is elevated.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Orders and margin expansion support a positive bias, but the new post-spin reporting base complicates comparisons.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 ex-aerospace orders rose 16%, backlog was about $20B and adjusted EPS guidance increased.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog conversion and automation margins validate the pure-play thesis.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Portfolio exits, mix or post-spin stranded costs cloud the guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable implied move was found; separation-related positioning adds noise.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 guidance increased, but clean apples-to-apples estimate revisions are limited.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Flat Q4 organic sales, weaker category volumes and an 8% FY27 cost drag put volume and margin recovery under pressure.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Street EPS is about $1.89-$1.94; investors need proof that organic growth can accelerate within 1%-3% FY27 guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Productivity offsets costs, volume stabilizes and guidance is maintained.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Organic volume remains weak and input costs compress core margin.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 3.2%, a modest hurdle that could still be exceeded on a guidance reset.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published estimates show lower year-over-year EPS; reliable last-week breadth was unavailable.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q2 revenue headwinds and reduced constant-currency growth expectations create downside risk unless software and delayed deals rebound sharply.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $2.85-$2.87; the market needs software acceleration and confidence in roughly $1B of FCF growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Delayed deals close, Red Hat/data accelerate, and FCF stays on plan.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Software remains near 5%, consulting stagnates, or full-year growth slips again.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7.2%-8.0%, above recent average moves, so magnitude is expensive.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: A recent JPMorgan Buy contrasts with the weaker Q2 growth trajectory; revision evidence is mixed.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: A/B/C bearish; moderate disagreement on relief odds.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Ad beat or credible Muse monetization
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong ad growth is offset by doubled-down AI spending and a stock rally that requires credible monetization, not just engagement.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus revenue is about $63.35B, near the top of $61B-$64B guidance; capex and Muse economics dominate.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Ad pricing stays strong and management links Muse to monetization with disciplined 2027 capex.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: 2027 capex rises faster than revenue, free cash flow stays compressed, or Muse lacks economics.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 5.2%-5.7%; crowded expectations raise sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: BMO remained Hold over capex returns while headline consensus is still growth-positive.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All bearish, but Pass B was near Neutral; elevated disparity.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AFFO is improving, but site-rental revenue and EBITDA remain down year over year, leaving limited room for another operational wobble.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AFFO and leasing exceed the reset bar, helped by rates and cleaner tower focus.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Organic tower growth or AFFO guide softens despite the reset.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move was found; REIT factor moves can dominate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Company raised AFFO only slightly in Q2; current revision breadth was unavailable.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broadband erosion remains the core risk even as wireless growth and Peacock profitability make the downside case less clean.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Broadband losses shrink faster, wireless sustains record adds and Peacock profit persists.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Broadband pricing/subscriber trends worsen or the separation outlook adds uncertainty.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move was found; low valuation increases relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimate-revision evidence was insufficient for a stronger call.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 5% delivery beat and record storage clash with fragile automotive economics and a valuation driven by distant autonomy milestones.
